data.name: A7C II Tools 3.0.3 (important fixes / 重要修复)
data.body:
**A7C II Tools 3.0.3 — 重要修复版 / important fixes**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **本版本修复了几个重要问题，建议所有人更新。**
> **This release fixes several important bugs. Everyone should update.**

[中文说明](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [English guide](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.md)

## 修复的问题 / Fixed

- **自定义外观的基础外观不同步**：写入外观、恢复槽位为 ST、一键安装和一键恢复原厂时，会同时同步相机运行中的基础外观和已保存的 ST 设置，不再出现“保存的是 ST、实际运行的是黑白等旧基础外观”。 / **Custom look base out of sync**: LUT writes, slot resets, one-click install and factory restore now sync the running base look with the saved ST setting, so a slot no longer runs on an old base (such as B&W) while ST is saved.
- **机械快门也会响自定义快门声**：现在只有电子快门拍摄时才播放自定义声音；机械快门和电子前帘走原生静音路径。旧版声音补丁会在重新开启或保存时自动升级。 / **Mechanical shutter also played the custom sound**: the custom sound now plays only for electronic-shutter captures; mechanical and EFC captures stay silent. Older sound patches upgrade automatically when you enable or save again.
- **USB 读取出错（“Wrong senser sequence”）**：修正 USB 收包方式，不再在读取过程中吞掉或错读数据。只读操作出错后会自动让相机退出服务模式，通常不必再取电池；日志会写出出错时正在读取的文件。 / **USB read errors ("Wrong senser sequence")**: fixed how USB replies are received; after a read-only failure the app returns the camera from service mode, usually without a battery pull, and logs the file being read.
- **声音操作被旧任务记录拦下**：保存、试听、开启、关闭、恢复原厂音效和核对都不再被之前未完成的任务拦截；保存和试听按当前选择的音频覆盖。 / **Sound actions blocked by old task records**: Save, Audition, On, Off, Restore original sound and Verify are no longer blocked by earlier unfinished tasks; Save and Audition replace the sound with your current selection.
- **Mac 声音保存崩溃**：保存声音时不再运行会在部分 Mac 上崩溃的仿真组件。 / **Mac crash when saving sound**: saving no longer runs the emulator that crashed on some Macs.
- **安装中断后续接**：程序已写完、只差设置的安装可以直接续接设置；旧备份核对按钮误点时会引导到正确的核对。 / Installs interrupted after the programs were written resume at the settings step; the old-backup verify button now redirects a mistaken click.
- 一键恢复原厂写入完成后，旧的声音记录随即停用；声音诊断包附带工作区摘要，问题更好排查。 / After factory restore writes, old sound records are retired; sound diagnostics include a workspace summary.

## 下载 / Downloads

| 文件 / File | 说明 / Description |
| --- | --- |
| `A7C2Tools-Windows-x64.zip` | Windows 10/11 x64。整包解压后运行 `A7C2Tools.exe`。 / Extract everything and run `A7C2Tools.exe`. |
| `A7C2Tools-macOS-arm64.dmg` | macOS 14+ Apple Silicon。未签名，首次需在“隐私与安全性”中允许。 / Unsigned; allow once in Privacy & Security. |
| `A7C2-Looks-and-DCP-3.0.3.zip` | 创意外观与 DCP，与 3.0.0 内容相同。 / Looks and DCPs, same content as 3.0.0. |

更新方法：关闭旧版，解压／安装新版即可；相机里已安装的内容和电脑上的任务记录都会保留。用过电子快门声的，建议更新后在“电子快门声音”页重新点一次“保存当前自定义声音”，让机械快门不再发声。 / To update, close the old version and extract/install the new one; camera contents and task records are kept. If you use the shutter sound, click Save on the shutter sound page once after updating so mechanical captures stay silent.

## 已知问题 / Known issues

- 竖屏创意外观选择页外框仍偏粗；橙色刻度指针朝向尚未修正。 / Portrait Creative Look selection border is still thick; the orange gauge pointer orientation is not yet corrected.

完整更新记录 / Full changelog: [docs/zh-CN/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/changelog.md) · [docs/en/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/en/changelog.md)

data.name: A7C II Tools 3.0.2 (bug fixes / 问题修复)
data.body:
**A7C II Tools 3.0.2 — 问题修复版 / bug-fix release**

> [!NOTE]
> **本版本只修复 3.0.1 发布后用户反馈的软件问题，没有新功能。3.0.1 使用正常、没有遇到下列问题的，无需更新。**
> **This release only fixes software bugs reported after 3.0.1; there are no new features. If 3.0.1 works for you and you haven't hit the problems below, you don't need to update.**

[中文说明](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [English guide](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.md)

## 修复的问题 / Fixed

- **相机 `/usr` 空间不足（错误 -28 / ENOSPC）**：旧版本未完成的任务会在相机里留下整套名称备份文件，占满空间，导致安装、竖屏和恢复都报 -28。现在**一键恢复原厂会先自动删除这些旧任务遗留的备份**，再进行恢复。遇到 -28 的用户：更新后先点一次“恢复原厂功能”，完成后再重新安装。 / **Camera `/usr` out of space (error -28 / ENOSPC)**: unfinished jobs of older versions could leave full sets of name backups that filled the space, so installs, Vertical Display and restore failed with -28. **One-click factory restore now first removes those stale backups.** If you hit -28: update, run Restore factory functions once, then install again.
- **残留的只读检测报告卡住后续任务**（“Existing temporary state needs recovery: a7c2.probe.result”）：现在会自动清理。 / **A leftover read-only probe report blocking later jobs** is now cleared automatically.
- **相机停在服务模式时**（“Normal Mass Storage USB serial is required…”）：改为中文提示取出电池约 1 分钟后重试。 / A camera stuck in service mode now gets a clear message to remove the battery for a minute.
- **先装自定义外观、后启用 FL2/FL3 时颜色不对**：同时更新相机实际使用的曲线表副本。 / **FL2/FL3 enabled after custom looks**: the second curve table the camera actually uses is now updated too.
- **写入外观前先把所选槽位保存为 ST；恢复原厂前先把六个槽位和当前选择保存为 ST**，避免中途失败后留下指向 FL2/FL3 的配方。 / Selected slots are saved as ST before LUT writes, and all six slots before factory restore, so an interrupted run can't leave recipes pointing at FL2/FL3.
- **Windows Lightroom 插件安装失败**：ExifTool 不再覆盖可能正在使用的文件；只有插件失败时，重试只做电脑端步骤。 / **Windows Lightroom plugin install failure**: ExifTool no longer overwrites files that may be in use; a plugin-only failure retries just the computer-side step.
- 重启后核对不一致时，诊断包记录更详细的差异信息。 / More detailed diagnostics when post-restart verification finds a mismatch.

## 下载 / Downloads

| 文件 / File | 说明 / Description |
| --- | --- |
| `A7C2Tools-Windows-x64.zip` | Windows 10/11 x64。整包解压后运行 `A7C2Tools.exe`。 / Extract everything and run `A7C2Tools.exe`. |
| `A7C2Tools-macOS-arm64.dmg` | macOS 14+ Apple Silicon。未签名，首次需在“隐私与安全性”中允许。 / Unsigned; allow once in Privacy & Security. |
| `A7C2-Looks-and-DCP-3.0.2.zip` | 创意外观与 DCP，与 3.0.0 内容相同。 / Looks and DCPs, same content as 3.0.0. |

更新方法：关闭旧版，解压／安装新版即可；相机里已安装的内容和电脑上的任务记录都会保留。 / To update, close the old version and extract/install the new one; what's installed on the camera and your task records are kept.

## 已知问题 / Known issues

- 竖屏创意外观选择页外框仍偏粗；橙色刻度指针朝向尚未修正。 / Portrait Creative Look selection border is still thick; the orange gauge pointer orientation is not yet corrected.
- 本版修复已通过自动测试、离线仿真和打包检查，尚未在出问题的相机上逐项实机验证。 / These fixes pass automated tests, offline emulation and packaging checks, but have not each been re-tested on the affected cameras.

完整更新记录 / Full changelog: [docs/zh-CN/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/changelog.md) · [docs/en/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/en/changelog.md)

data.name: A7C II Tools 3.0.1 (bug fixes / 问题修复)
data.body:
**A7C II Tools 3.0.1 — 问题修复版 / bug-fix release**

> [!NOTE]
> **本版本只修复 3.0.0 发布后用户反馈的软件问题，没有新功能。3.0.0 使用正常、没有遇到下列问题的，无需更新。**
> **This release only fixes software bugs reported after 3.0.0; there are no new features. If 3.0.0 works for you and you haven't hit the problems below, you don't need to update.**

[中文说明](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [English guide](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.md)

## 修复的问题 / Fixed

- **一键恢复原厂被旧任务卡住**：旧记录无法读取、来自多台机身、上次恢复后又装过功能导致每次都“核对失败”等情况，现在都会按相机当前内容重新恢复，不再被旧记录阻挡。 / **Factory restore stuck on old tasks**: unreadable records, records from several bodies, or a finished restore followed by new installs (verification failing on every click) no longer block it; it re-plans from the camera's current contents.
- **一键安装在名称写完后遇到 USB 错误就无法继续**（“Unknown operation after name commit”）：现在会重新核对名称和原程序后继续安装程序。 / **One-click install could not continue after a USB error that came after the names were written** ("Unknown operation after name commit"): it now re-verifies and continues with the programs.
- **恢复时 `/usr` 空间不足、`/usr` 仍可写**：提示会显示进度和处理方法（完整断电后再点同一按钮继续）。 / **Out of `/usr` space, or `/usr` still writable, during restore**: the message now gives the progress and what to do (power-cycle, then click the same button).
- **电子快门声**：转换失败时显示具体原因（例如所选片段是静音）；试听前先检查是否已转换；试听在调用相机前就停止时会自动解除占用。默认片段长度改为 0.5 秒。 / **Shutter sound**: conversion failures show the actual reason (e.g. a silent selection); audition checks for a converted clip first; an audition that stopped before reaching the camera releases its lock. The default clip length is now 0.5 s.
- **Mac**：修复部分新系统启动时 SciPy 加载报错，以及 USB 设备列表解析报错。 / **Mac**: fixes a SciPy load error at launch on newer macOS and a USB device-list parsing error.
- **Windows 驱动**：第一次一键安装前会提示先安装驱动；驱动失败时提示改用 Zadig；连接与驱动页的自动安装按钮旁新增“用 Zadig 手动安装驱动”入口。README 新增详细的 Zadig 手动安装步骤。 / **Windows drivers**: the first one-click install suggests installing drivers first; driver failures point to Zadig, and the connection page has an "Install with Zadig" button next to the automatic install. The READMEs now have detailed manual Zadig steps.
- 早期预览版留下的任务可以继续。 / Jobs left by earlier previews can be resumed.

## 下载 / Downloads

| 文件 / File | 说明 / Description |
| --- | --- |
| `A7C2Tools-Windows-x64.zip` | Windows 10/11 x64。整包解压后运行 `A7C2Tools.exe`。 / Extract everything and run `A7C2Tools.exe`. |
| `A7C2Tools-macOS-arm64.dmg` | macOS 14+ Apple Silicon。未签名，首次需在“隐私与安全性”中允许。 / Unsigned; allow once in Privacy & Security. |
| `A7C2-Looks-and-DCP-3.0.1.zip` | 创意外观与 DCP，与 3.0.0 内容相同。 / Looks and DCPs, same content as 3.0.0. |

更新方法：关闭旧版，解压／安装新版即可；相机里已安装的内容和电脑上的任务记录都会保留。 / To update, close the old version and extract/install the new one; what's installed on the camera and your task records are kept.

## 已知问题 / Known issues

- 竖屏创意外观选择页外框仍偏粗；橙色刻度指针朝向尚未修正。 / Portrait Creative Look selection border is still thick; the orange gauge pointer orientation is not yet corrected.
- 本版修复已通过自动测试和打包检查，尚未在相机上逐项实机验证；目前实机验证都在一台相机上完成。 / These fixes pass automated tests and packaging checks but have not each been re-tested on a camera; all camera verification so far is on one body.

完整更新记录 / Full changelog: [docs/zh-CN/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/changelog.md) · [docs/en/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/en/changelog.md)

data.name: A7C II Tools 3.0.0
data.body:
**A7C II Tools 3.0.0** — the first release with a full desktop interface for the Sony A7C II (ILCE-7CM2) on firmware 2.01. 第一个带完整图形界面的版本。

[中文说明](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [English guide](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/README.md)

## 下载 / Downloads

| 文件 / File | 说明 / Description |
| --- | --- |
| `A7C2Tools-Windows-x64.zip` | Windows 10/11 x64。整包解压后运行 `A7C2Tools.exe`；`Profiles` 文件夹里是 15 组配对的 DCP 和 `.a7look`。 / Extract everything and run `A7C2Tools.exe`; `Profiles` holds the 15 paired DCP/`.a7look` files. |
| `A7C2Tools-macOS-arm64.dmg` | macOS 14+ Apple Silicon。拖进“应用程序”；未签名，首次需在“隐私与安全性”中允许。**Mac 实机 USB 尚未验证。** / Unsigned; allow once in Privacy & Security. **USB on a real Mac is not yet verified.** |
| `A7C2-Looks-and-DCP-3.0.0.zip` | 创意外观与 DCP：15 组配对、默认六款外观、全部 18 款 DCP 以及 FL2/FL3 的 DCP。 / Looks and DCPs: 15 pairs, the default six looks, all 18 DCPs plus the FL2/FL3 DCPs. |

## 使用顺序 / How to start

1. **装驱动（Windows）**：连接与驱动 → 准备两阶段驱动并测试连接。出错先“卸载相机驱动”，重新插线后再装。 / Install drivers first; on errors, uninstall the camera driver, replug and reinstall.
2. **推荐**：写入前做一次“检测 USB 连接稳定性（只读）”，约 2 分钟。 / Recommended: run the 2-minute read-only USB stability check before writing.
3. **用过旧版本？先恢复原厂功能**，断电重开后核对完成，再安装。 / Used an earlier version? Restore factory functions first.
4. **首页 · 一键安装** → 按提示断电重开 → 接回后点“继续安装”。 / One-click install, cold reload, then Continue.

## 主要内容 / Highlights

- 一键安装：六款内置外观、FL2/FL3、电子快门声、竖屏显示，可选 Lightroom 插件。 / One-click install of six looks, FL2/FL3, shutter sound and Vertical Display.
- 无需旧备份的一键恢复原厂功能。 / Factory-function restore without an old backup.
- DCP/CUBE 离线转换为 `.a7look`，无需 Lightroom。 / Offline DCP/CUBE → `.a7look` conversion.
- 自定义快门声（转换、音量调节、保存）。 / Custom shutter sound.
- 新的蓝白界面；更严格的 USB 稳定性检测；Windows 驱动检测改用 SetupAPI。 / New light interface, stricter USB check, SetupAPI driver detection.

## 已知问题 / Known issues

- 竖屏创意外观选择页外框仍偏粗；刻度已横向显示，但橙色指针朝向尚未修正。 / Portrait Creative Look selection border is still thick; the orange gauge pointer orientation is not yet corrected.
- Mac 实机 USB 写入尚未验证；目前所有实机验证都在一台相机上完成。 / Mac USB is untested; all camera verification so far is on one body.

完整更新记录 / Full changelog: [docs/zh-CN/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/changelog.md) · [docs/en/changelog.md](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/main/docs/en/changelog.md)

data.name: v2.2-preview.1 — Recovery + USB connection fix / 恢复与 USB 修复
data.body:
## 简体中文

- **独立 Recovery：**从所选完整存档或原 FL23 backup2 回退，不需要原工作目录或任何 LUT Job。先保存当前状态的压缩副本，再恢复程序、项目相关名称／设置，并完整读回。[Recovery 操作说明](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.2-preview.1/docs/zh-CN/recovery.md)。
- **三个入口分工：**FL23 安装／核对，LUT 导入／恢复单槽，Recovery 完整回退。FL23 已移除恢复命令和桌面恢复按钮。
- **支持两种安装顺序：**先 FL23 后 LUT、先 LUT 后 FL23，均保留对方修改；核对流程兼容预期的后续修改。
- **缩小 LUT 备份：**共用压缩基础数据，并记录指定槽位写入前的状态，后续导入只保留变化数据，不重复存整份。共享存储目录需要和任务／备份一起保留。
- **恢复单槽：**恢复该槽原来的色表、名称、配方，也支持撤销首次启用；保留其他槽及 FL23。不以固件或备份文件哈希作为恢复门槛，仍核对改写字节并完整读回。
- **FL23 按版本准入：**确认机型及用户填写的固件版本 2.01，不再使用固件来源哈希白名单；提醒其他项目修改可能冲突，保留真实改写位置的冲突检查。
- **USB 连接：**直接进入服务认证，不再被存储 `02/04/01` 或应用查询 Busy 拦住。确认 USB 型号后，从服务备份读取 AP 四字节序列号（`0x00E70003`），沿用原十六进制文本摘要，兼容已有备份。不需要单独 USB 修正工具；Windows 设备驱动仍需安装。
- **解释失败原因：**LUT 内置任务诊断，根据已保存证据解释名称事务失败，不重新打开 USB，也不盲目重复写入。

**验证情况：**离线通过 131 项 LUT 用例（缺少私人样本而跳过 35 项）、22 项 FL23、46 项主机／USB 用例，其中包含 9 项直接服务认证／失败处理案例；历史真实备份重建的机身绑定与原值一致。另有 7 项真实文件顺序／单槽案例及 44 项原生名称系统调用／故障案例通过。本次发布更新未操作相机；用户报告同一路径安装成功，属于单独证据。实机完整回退和 Mac USB 仍未测试。[验证证据与限制](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.2-preview.1/docs/zh-CN/technical/validation.md)。

按机主授权，这些修复已包含在 `main`，并更新到同一个 v2.2-preview.1 提交／Release。原 v2.1／v1.0 继续保留。完整工具包和单文件工具见[预览版发布页](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/releases/tag/v2.2-preview.1)。

## English

- **Independent Recovery:** restore the selected complete checkpoint or original FL23 backup2 without the original workspace or any LUT job. The tool saves a compressed copy of the current state, restores programs, project names/settings, and fully reads back the result. [Recovery instructions](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.2-preview.1/docs/en/recovery.md).
- **Separate responsibilities:** FL23 installs/verifies; LUT imports/restores individual slots; Recovery performs complete rollback. FL23's restore command and desktop button have been removed.
- **Both installation orders:** FL23 → LUT and LUT → FL23 preserve each other's changes. Verification accepts the expected later changes.
- **Smaller LUT backups:** share a compressed foundation and record the selected slot's pre-write state. Later imports retain changed data instead of repeated complete copies. Keep the shared storage directories with the jobs/backups.
- **Single-slot restoration:** restore its previous table, title and recipe, including undoing first activation, while preserving other slots and FL23. No firmware or backup-file hash admission checks; edited-byte checks and full readback remain.
- **FL23 admission:** check the camera model and user-entered firmware version 2.01, without a firmware-provenance hash whitelist. Warn about other projects' modifications; retain actual patch-position conflict checks.
- **USB connection:** authenticate directly instead of blocking on storage `02/04/01` or application-query Busy. Confirm the USB model and bind the service backup's four-byte AP serial (`0x00E70003`) using the original hex-text digest, retaining existing backups. No separate USB-fix tool is required; Windows device drivers are still required.
- **Failure explanations:** integrated LUT job diagnostics explain native-name transaction failures from saved evidence without reopening USB or blindly repeating a write.

**Validation:** offline suites passed: 131 LUT cases (35 skipped without private fixtures), 22 FL23 cases and 46 host/USB cases, including nine service-first connection/failure cases. Historical real backup data reproduces its original body binding. Separately, 7 real-file order/slot cases and 44 native-name syscall/failure cases passed. This release update did not operate a camera; the user's reported service-route installation is separate evidence. Physical complete Recovery and Mac USB remain untested. [Evidence and limits](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.2-preview.1/docs/en/technical/validation.md).

These fixes are included in `main` and the updated v2.2-preview.1 commit/release, as authorized by the owner. Existing v2.1/v1.0 releases remain available. ZIP and single-file tools are in the [preview release](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/releases/tag/v2.2-preview.1).

## Downloads / 下载

- `a7c2-tools-2.2-preview.1.zip`: complete source-layout tools and bilingual guides / 完整工具及双语说明。
- `lut.py`: standalone LUT import and single-slot restore / 单文件 LUT 导入与单槽恢复。
- `recovery.py`: standalone complete rollback / 单文件完整回退。
- Python/device dependencies are still required / 仍需安装 Python 和设备依赖。
- [Original DCP files / 原始 DCP](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/releases/download/v2.1/a7c2-dcp-profiles-2026-10-18.zip).

data.name: v2.1 — FL23 and Custom LUT/DCP
data.body:
LUT/DCP importer for **Sony A7C II / ILCE-7CM2 firmware 2.01**. No AI or prior FL23 installation is required.

- **`lut.py`**: single-file Python CLI. [Setup](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.1/docs/en/manual.md) · [File-to-camera guide](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.1/docs/en/custom-lut.md).
- **`a7c2-tools-2.1.zip`**: complete source, English/Simplified Chinese guides and the existing FL23 Windows CLI/desktop entry.
- **`a7c2-dcp-profiles-2026-10-18.zip`**: 18 unchanged original DCPs, including Astia, with original attribution/notices.
- **`SHA256SUMS.txt`**: download checksums.

This build fixes normal-USB body binding, recognized busy/no-card service acquisition and false installation failures caused by unrelated runtime fields. It keeps complete backups, exact program fingerprints/readbacks, writable AP-setting preservation and four protected CP units. FL23 code is unchanged by this update.

On one Windows camera with an existing six-look installation, slot 5 was imported from the Ricoh GR Positive Film DCP. The exact packaged `lut.py` then imported **Astia into slot 4** using `import --write`. Both jobs passed duplicate backups, preflight, actual writes, full readbacks, cold-load, owner preview/photo acceptance and standalone reload verification to `COMPLETE`. Other slots and FL2/FL3 were preserved. Software checks: 82 LUT, 8 FL23 and 37 host tests. [Evidence and limits](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.1/docs/en/technical/validation.md).

**Validation scope:** stock first-install, physical Mac USB and this job's physical restoration remain untested. Color conversion uses a shared one-scene approximation, not the complete Adobe renderer or exact Fuji/Ricoh matching. This is not a Sony-signed firmware update. `main` now contains both FL23 and LUT/DCP, with separate user guides and AI reproduction guides.

---

用于 **Sony A7C II／ILCE-7CM2 固件 2.01** 的 LUT／DCP 导入器，不依赖 AI，也不必先安装 FL23。

单独使用 LUT，下载 **`lut.py`** 即可：[安装依赖](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.1/docs/zh-CN/manual.md) → [从文件到相机的八步教程](https://github.com/QAQLeonard/a7c2-fl23-research/blob/v2.1/docs/zh-CN/custom-lut.md)。完整工具包另含源码、中英文说明及原 FL23 Windows 命令行／桌面入口；独立 DCP 包包含 Astia 在内的 18 个原始文件和原署名／许可；校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

本版修复普通 USB 机身绑定、已知忙碌／无卡服务连接，以及无关运行字段误拦截。保留完整备份、精确程序指纹／读回、可写 AP 设置及四个受保护 CP 单元核对；未改动 FL23 代码。

已在一台 Windows 相机的既有六款版本上导入第 5 槽理光 GR 正片，再使用发布附件同一份 `lut.py`，以 `import --write` 导入**第 4 槽 Astia**。两次均通过双份备份、只校验、真实写入、完整读回、冷启动、机主预览／拍照验收及单文件重载核对，达到 `COMPLETE`；其他槽位和 FL2／FL3 保留。通过 82 项 LUT、8 项 FL23、37 项主机测试。原厂首次导入、Mac USB 和实机还原仍未验证。默认色彩映射为单场景近似，不是完整 Adobe 渲染或富士／理光精确复刻，也不是 Sony 签名固件。

`main` 已包含 FL23 和 LUT／DCP 两个独立入口，并分别提供用户及 AI 复现说明。下载 DCP 不会自动写入相机，请按教程操作。


Version 2.1 packages the tested preview implementation with updated main-branch documentation and download links; only the CLI version string changed in executable source. FL23-only users can continue using v1.0.

v2.1 将已实测的预览版实现与最新 main 文档／下载链接统一打包；可执行源码仅改变版本字符串。只使用 FL23 的用户仍可下载 v1.0。
